what: Allstate insures cars and homes in the United States, selling through its own agents, directly online and through the Esurance and National General brands. It also sells protection plans and identity protection.
customers: US households buying car, home and renters insurance.
money: vehicle service contracts, identity protection and device protection
moat: Brand recognition built over decades, a large agent network and claims data that supports pricing.
risks: Wildfires and severe storms produce large losses in single quarters
It lost car insurance customers while raising prices to restore profitability
Repair and medical cost inflation can outrun premium increases
State regulators can delay rate increases
opportunities: Several years of rate increases have restored underwriting profit
It is spending on advertising again to win back customers
Selling its employer benefits businesses raised capital for buybacks
watch: Policies in force, which shows whether it is growing again, and the combined ratio.
